project: Adobe AI Generations — CEP Runtime, Gemini & Release Hardening
purpose: Canonical UI plan for the current Adobe_AI_Generations-04 production blockers: GitHub Actions startup, Gemini image-generation host acceptance, Gemini capability metadata drift, source-to-runtime identity, LoopTool mutation authorization, and Windows distribution hardening.
authority_rule: Live Adobe_AI_Generations-04 source, PR state, current branch/HEAD, AE/CEP runtime evidence, release workflows, built artifacts, signatures and hashes outrank this projection.

plan_truth.next_single_question: Can GitHub Actions initialize and execute real jobs for the current Adobe repository before any PR is promoted as CI-proven?

nodes.title: Weekly production audit baseline
nodes.summary: User-supplied 26 Oct–2 Nov audit records main HEAD 6904f80c (30 Oct), four recent main commits, PR #345 as the scoped Gemini image-generation correction, GitHub Actions startup_failure with zero jobs, Main PC thin dev loader v2.3.52, and no live AfterFX/CEPHtmlEngine during the inspection.

nodes.title: Restore GitHub Actions job execution
nodes.summary: Actions run 41386703624 is recorded as startup_failure / BuildFailed with zero jobs. Treat this as workflow/platform initialization failure, not test failure. Acceptance requires jobs to actually start and report results.

nodes.title: Check for retired Veo 3.1 preview endpoints
nodes.summary: 19–26 Oct audit records veo-3.1-generate-preview, veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview and veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview as shut down on 22 Oct 2026. Search Letterblack integrations for those identifiers. If present, migrate through the replacement API contract and prove real generation, operation completion, asset retrieval and compositing validation. Do not treat this as an active Letterblack defect unless repository/runtime usage is found.

nodes.title: PR #345 — Gemini image generation host acceptance
nodes.summary: Source patch and focused mocked provider tests are recorded as passing. Production acceptance remains open: real Gemini API generation → provider result → gallery persistence → After Effects import → host receipt.

nodes.title: Gemini capability metadata drift
nodes.summary: Issue #339 remains open in the audit. Correct image-input, image-output, vision and long-context descriptors in GeminiProvider.listAvailableModels(); PR #345 intentionally does not close the entire metadata contract.

nodes.title: Source-to-installed runtime identity
nodes.summary: Main PC audit records installed com.letterblack.genai.workspace v2.3.52 as a thin loader targeting D:\Developments\40_AEP_Letterblack_GenAI\Letterblack_Gen_AI\src\index.html, while the checkout is feat/windows-authenticode-signing at cece8c25 with 90 dirty paths. Reconcile exact revision, loader target and deployed source before host acceptance.

nodes.title: Preserve explicit mutation authorization
nodes.summary: PR #340/#341 are recorded draft. Authentication plus validation tokens do not establish artist approval. Required acceptance is ALLOW: explicit authority → bounded mutation → observed AE effect → receipt; DENY: unauthorised mutation remains blocked.

nodes.title: Windows Authenticode architecture
nodes.summary: v2.3.52 release path disables Electron signing discovery and tolerates signing failure. Fix scripts/installers/build-win-installer.mjs so the inner Electron executable is signed and signing failure aborts. Configure a trusted Windows code-signing identity/provider rather than relying on Apple credentials.

nodes.title: Sign + verify final Inno EXE
nodes.summary: After Inno compilation, Authenticode-sign Letterblack-GenAI-Windows-vX.Y.Z.exe with timestamping. Patch .github/workflows/release.yml to verify both the inner Electron EXE and final installer with Windows-native signature checks; absent/untrusted/wrong-publisher signatures must fail the release.

nodes.title: Remove hidden PowerShell elevation
nodes.summary: Current installer main.js uses hidden powershell.exe + Start-Process -Verb RunAs. Replace with a conventional elevation mechanism where possible; otherwise document necessity and prove it is bounded. Re-audit tasklist/process enumeration, staging/removal and executable-launch behavior for AV heuristic reduction.

nodes.title: Artifact provenance + hashes
nodes.summary: Generate and publish SHA-256 for Windows EXE, DMG, ZXP and canonical ZIP; bind all to tag + source commit. Compare the exact Gumroad ZIP hash against the GitHub release bundle before distribution. Preserve existing macOS Developer ID/notarization/stapling and ZXP signature gates.

nodes.title: Clean-machine + AV release acceptance
nodes.summary: Clean Windows install/upgrade/uninstall smoke must prove signature trust, user-scope behavior, AE/CEP + ScriptUI placement and cleanup. Then review Defender/SmartScreen/VirusTotal against the exact signed hash. Do not require arbitrary zero detections; investigate behavioral detections.

nodes.title: Publish hardened replacement release
nodes.summary: Release sequence: development consolidation → AE runtime proof → PR main → pre-tag gate → tag → release.yml → signature/hash/provenance checks → clean-machine/AV review → GitHub Release → Gumroad replacement. No distribution before all P0 gates pass.

nodes.title: ComfyUI 0.43 controlled evaluation
nodes.summary: Evaluate ACEScg EXR handoff into After Effects 26.5: scene-linear values, alpha, channel precision and OCIO interpretation. Dynamic VRAM behavior remains hardware-specific and unproven.

nodes.title: Runway workflow/SVG/video evaluation
nodes.summary: Evaluate published workflow endpoints, higher-bitrate Seedance output and Ideogram Vector SVG import/editability with fixed reference assets. Capability availability does not by itself prove deterministic quality.

nodes.title: UXP compatibility preparation
nodes.summary: Preserve the architectural boundary: connected LLM reasons; CEP/future UXP owns context, validation, bounded host execution and evidence return. Prepare equivalent contract tests before migration.

nodes.title: Canva Craft controlled evaluation
nodes.summary: Historical 19–26 Oct brief records Craft model craft_v1_2k and async image generation. Evaluate typography/layout fidelity, export structure/editability and cost using fixed assets. Editable Canva elements must not be equated with native After Effects layers.
